forbidden_shortcuts: Do not replace the Spring XML application with a synthetic success command
Do not remove the Camel XML context from spring.xml

observable_symptom.command: cd /opt/camel && classpath=target/classes; while IFS= read -r jar; do case "$jar" in *camel-spring-xml-3.22.4.jar) ;; *) classpath="$classpath:$jar" ;; esac; done < <(find "$HOME/.m2/repository" -type f -name '*.jar' | sort); java -cp "$classpath" com.example.Main

fail_to_pass.description: The real Spring application loads the Camel XML namespace successfully after the missing module is declared.

pass_to_pass.description: The Maven project remains structurally valid and retains its real Spring XML resource before and after repair.
